map.根据墙面/顶面面积、涂刷遍数和油漆覆盖率,估算油漆用量和成本: Estimate paint usage and cost from wall/ceiling area, coats and paint coverage
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：Math.ceil(totalPaint ÷ buc: Core formula (by input variables): Math.ceil(totalPaint ÷ bucketSize)

map.翻新算两面墙 + 顶面乳胶漆升数，门窗口面积扣除避免买多造成浪费与色差。: For renovation, compute latex paint liters for two walls + ceiling, deduct door/window area to avoid buying too much and causing waste and color difference.
map.按遍数（2 底 + 2 面）与覆盖率 10–12 ㎡/L 估算采购桶数，避免不够: Estimate purchase buckets by coats (2 primer + 2 top) and coverage 10-12 m²/L, avoiding running short and a batch difference on refill.
map.不同房间分表面录入（客厅墙 / 卧室墙），分别计价，控制整体涂刷预算。: Enter different rooms by surface separately (living wall / bedroom wall), price separately, control overall painting budget.
map.算例（客厅墙 30 + 卧室墙 22 + 顶面 20㎡）: Example (living wall 30 + bedroom wall 22 + ceiling 20 m²)
map.合计 72㎡，遍数 2、覆盖率 10 ㎡/L → 用量 = 72×2÷10 =: Total 72 m², coats 2, coverage 10 m²/L → usage = 72×2÷10 = 14.4 L; 5 L/bucket needs 14.4÷5=2.88→3 buckets, unit price 280 CNY/bucket ≈ 840 CNY. Door/window deductions not counted; actual can save 1-2 buckets (each door/window about 1.5-2 m²).
map.乳胶漆理论 10–12 ㎡/L/遍，深色 / 多孔墙面取低值；实际损耗另加 10: Latex paint theoretical 10-12 m²/L/coat; dark/porous wall takes the low value; actual loss add 10%~15%. Primer and topcoat differ in coverage, recommend entering separately.
map.建议扣除门窗口面积，否则高估 1–2 桶。本工具支持按表面分别录入并汇总，扣除后: It is recommended to deduct door/window area, otherwise overestimate by 1-2 buckets. This tool supports entering by surface separately and summing, closer to real purchase after deduction.
